ctx.x: Around '68 I commenced to thinkin', then I had so much trouble with an organ player. I had an organ trio at the time at a place called the Purple Manor on 125th St. near Madison Avenue, and also at that particular time I was playing with a fella named Olatunji -- big African ensemble... I stayed with Olatunji for quite a while... And playing the African music is not easy, its way off. And I still had to do it by ear... but he liked the way I played. So I played some very important dates with Olatunji. For…
So were you reading chords then?

... No, the first time I ever thought about it must have been about '68 or '69. ... I say, "damn, everybody always ask me can I read this, can I read that. So I got no teacher, so I got a little old book. So I set myself up there with that book and count and one and two and three. See, the funny part it is one is all right but "and" is a pretty mean broad. ... But I get that, and I got a few more cues, and then I had to learn my fingerboard pretty good. ... As far as the reading thing, I finally got so I could…
